e93e8f7a26.q: What shift in vulnerability prioritization did organizations move toward instead of CVSS scoring?
e93e8f7a26.a: Organizations are moving away from CVSS scoring to a more risk-based approach, looking at things based on whether they had a known exploit and the probability of that exploit being utilized, and whether it was touching something that would actually impact customers or internal data, rather than throwing tens of thousands of vulnerabilities at engineers who cannot handle that volume.
